scope: P9016 post-020 SNP-free allele-signal ablation and synthetic calibration

freeze.prefit_hash_rule: Before any native or joint fit, write one freeze record containing sha256 of the exact protocol JSON, input manifest, source snapshot, and the stage-available prepared graph or locked x0 artifacts. Companion protocol MD/plan hashes and true mtimes are appended when those documents are available; if completed later, record them without backdating and do not block native preparation.
freeze.native_prepare_release_rule: Native preparation may start once the protocol JSON, input/source hashes, and prepared graph hashes for that stage are in the freeze record; MD/plan completion is not a native-start blocker.
freeze.later_artifact_hash_rule: Before any later joint-fit/evaluation release, append the actual MD/plan mtime and hash if they were not present earlier; never describe a later document as pre-fit.

read_boundary_for_this_freeze.scope: The no-reference/no-phase rule here describes this documentation pass; the future phase-free training pipeline may read its own newly generated x0 and candidate coordinates.
forbidden_before_endpoint_hash_lock: real phase columns or phase pairs
future_training_may_read: phase-free synthetic truth only in isolated post-hash evaluator

022_continuation.interpretation: Plan-B budget diagnostic; same 020 random endpoint, not an independent initialization repeat

semantic_corrections.active_boundary: No endpoint bead is at 0.90/0.95/0.99, but boundary inactivity does not prove that sphere parameterization has no optimization effect.
semantic_corrections.native_d_r2.0: different unit; do not mix with the repulsion hinge threshold
semantic_corrections.source_vs_current_pr: Saved-source numerical results are authoritative for historical reproduction when saved source and current pr differ.
semantic_corrections.budget_claim: All 020 stages and 022 stopped at fixed budgets; none is called sufficiently converged. The fixed 480 accepted-step real budget is retained without automatic extension.

024_r2_derived.orientation_bug_status: 024 v2 has corrected the fixed-reference anchor by swapping candidate rows only in the swapped case. Historical v1 matched/cross/contrast/minmargin/counts are unchanged; historical v1 absolute per-reference margins and contribution shares remain withheld unless regenerated under v2.

continuation_minus_v1_original.interpretation: approximately unchanged; not evidence of L2

025_native_preflight.parent_confirmed_scope: 3 native bundles, count conservation, and 63 graph-swap checks passed; hk_fdg was not called.
025_native_preflight.graph_only_invariance: Canonical graph/blob invariance does not assert native equivariance.

real_cohort_freeze.observation_unit: Aggregated unordered genomic bin-pair count C_ij
real_cohort_freeze.same_bin_policy: Keep same-bin records as a separate per-bin saturated nuisance layer; do not use them as geometry terms.

model_freeze.fit_scope: 1Mb-only full-grid joint fit; no multi-resolution warm start
model_freeze.joint_geometry: 40 tracks in one shared excluded-volume model
model_freeze.inter_contact_role: Use inter contacts for spatial placement and shared-volume geometry, not for maternal/paternal label accuracy.

exposure.observed_endpoint_inputs: All raw endpoints, including same-bin records; computed without phase or reference.

count_model.diagonal_profile: Per-bin saturated nuisance; no coordinate or p gradient.

variants.label: V1 original sphere / observed endpoint
variants.only_change: none relative to new 1Mb V1 model
variants.starting_point_note: New 1Mb starts; not a replay of the 020 multi-resolution path.

variants.label: identity-core smooth sphere map
variants.only_change: replace C0 sphere map by fixed identity-core smooth map

variants.label: direct Cartesian finite-only boundary sensitivity
variants.only_change: direct physical x variables with no hard sphere
variants.interpretation: Descriptive boundary/feasible-domain sensitivity; C0 -> C2-free changes parameterization and feasible domain together and cannot be attributed to boundary alone.

identity_core_map.coordinate: x = s*y/r for r>0; x=0 for r=0

excluded_searches.historical_020_consensus: Retain as historical control; do not run a new consensus arm.

assignment.cis_rule: Both endpoints use the same random copy.

native_bridge.terminal_and_zero_contact_beads: Included; no endpoint/grid bead is dropped.

graph_canonicalization.per_chromosome_primary: Sort integer AA/BB cis offdiag edge signatures by numeric local-bin pair and count using fixed encoding.
graph_canonicalization.primary_choice: Use the smaller byte key as canonical copy A.
graph_canonicalization.tie_break: Use incidence signature sorted by other chromosome, self local bin, other local bin, and count while ignoring partner-copy labels.
graph_canonicalization.remaining_tie: Fail the preflight; retain the seed and do not silently swap or replace it.
graph_canonicalization.audit_scopes: 20 single-chromosome swap vectors plus one all-chromosome swap vector

x0_lock.native_finalization: Run native once over all 40 tracks, then one common all-track centering and uniform scale to max radius 0.8.

failure_policy.bug_retry: Allowed only on the same frozen data, seed, budget, and variant; record original and new source hashes and label it a retry, not an independent repeat.

synthetic_calibration_freeze.purpose: Numerical implementation and failure-mode calibration; not a claim that native real initialization is recovered or biologically matched.

generator.lognormal_parameterization: For N2/P2, draw np.exp(default_rng(seed).normal(0, sigma, N)) with sigma=0.4, then divide by the realized full-grid mean; do not substitute a population log mean.
generator.sampling: Fixed-total integer multinomial within the declared count groups.
generator.zero_count_policy: Record actual fixture zero count; never substitute realzeros=3009436.

worker_inputs.C0_C1_C2_map_C2_free_exposure: Recompute observed-endpoint exposure from synthetic observed counts.

initialization.common_normalization: One common normalization to max radius 0.8 per fixture

synthetic_calibration_freeze.ordering: Write all fixture truth/observed-data freeze and prepare artifacts first; fit workers receive observed data only; hash all fit coordinates and endpoints before isolated truth evaluation.

truth_validation_gates.invalid_policy: Mark fixture invalid and retain it; do not replace its seeds.

negative_N.common_truth: Mean of the two truth distance matrices per chromosome; use this common matrix for both candidate-copy comparisons.

scale_definition.mask: the same finite unordered off-diagonal mask for both candidate and truth
scale_definition.sC: sqrt(mean of squared candidate distances from both candidate copies over the common mask)
scale_definition.sT: sqrt(mean of squared truth distances from both truth copies over the common mask)); for N use the common-truth matrix duplicated for the two copies

negative_N.candidate_shape_error: For each candidate copy report RMS(Dc_copy/sC - Dt_copy/sT) against the common truth, with per-chromosome mean and max.
negative_N.negative_only_diagnostic: RMS((DcA-DcB)/sC) using the same common mask and sC
negative_N.contrast_near_zero_interpretation: Algebraic property of the same-shape construction; not proof that a method cannot fabricate a split.

positive_P.scale_definition: Use the same per-chromosome sC/sT definition as N: both candidate copies and both own-truth copies share one scale on the same finite unordered off-diagonal mask; preserve relative copy scale and do not rescale copies separately.

observed_readonly_snapshot.single_worker_rss: must be measured before production launch

memory_gate.below_threshold: Do not start a new worker; wait for already-running workers; do not change the optimization budget.

runtime_estimate.wall_time: Several hours; no linear speedup guarantee

reference.read_only_after: All 15 endpoints, within-variant selections, coordinate hashes, and fit source hashes are locked.

mask.coverage_failure_policy: Record mismatch and mark affected arm n/a; never silently remove a failed arm or change denominators.

orientation_policy.direct_metrics: matched=(a+d)/2; cross_matched=(b+c)/2; contrast=matched-cross_matched; margin_ref1=a-b; margin_ref2=d-c; minmargin=min(margin_ref1,margin_ref2)
orientation_policy.selection: Compare direct_original=(rho_A_mat+rho_B_pat)/2 and cross_original=(rho_A_pat+rho_B_mat)/2 once per chromosome; select the larger orientation with no local copy repair.
orientation_policy.swapped_case: Swap candidate rows A/B only; never swap reference mat/pat columns.
orientation_policy.best_swap_bias: The best-overall-swap selection bias is retained and reported, not corrected away.
orientation_policy.tie_policy: If abs(direct_original-cross_original)<=1e-12, fixed_orientation=unresolved_tie, retain raw four rho, set contrast=0, do not count both_positive, and set fixed-reference margins/minmargin n/a for that chromosome.

reporting_order.per_seed: First pair each seed across the same 20 chromosomes and retain all 20 rows and statuses.
reporting_order.per_chromosome: Then average the effect for each chromosome over all three seeds.
reporting_order.cross_seed_summary: A primary three-seed summary requires all planned three seeds valid. If any comparison has a failed seed or no valid coordinates, report the main three-seed summary as n/a with planned_seed_count=3 and valid_seed_count; optionally provide an explicitly labelled available-seed description, never a silent two-seed primary result.
reporting_order.biological_replication: The 20 chromosomes and three initialization seeds are not biological replicates; do not pool 60 chromosome rows as n=60.

bootstrap.interval: Percentile interval over within-cell chromosome resampling.
bootstrap.interpretation: Structural/technical variation within one cell, not biological replication and not a p-value.

scope_limits.l2_status: remains unestablished unless a separate predeclared long-range criterion is later satisfied; this R2-only protocol does not upgrade L2 by itself

protocol_checks_required_before_release: real eligible-pair and zero-count totals retained
orientation mappings use fixed mat/pat reference columns
all 21 per-bundle and 63 aggregate graph-swap audits recorded
all seeds and budgets match this JSON
failed arms remain present with n/a status

claim_policy.L1: Historical chr1 signal remains separate from this not-yet-run ablation.
claim_policy.L2: Not established by 020/022/023/024 or by this freeze.
claim_policy.L3: Retracted for the solver class; this protocol tests only the registered variants.
